description: The files the string check walks past, said once for both gates. A gate prints the rule it holds in the message a reader hits, so the reader reaches the rule without asking, and that message is a string in source — which the string check would otherwise refuse. The oxlint rule reads this through packages/devtools/src/tag-printing-gates.ts and the Python check reads it directly, so a new gate is one edit here rather than one per tier. The tag test in apps/api/tests/coding-rules-tags.test.ts holds the same set for the tag walk and pairs it against the files that still cite a tag; a file listed here that no longer prints one is a line to delete from both.
